tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}1. ch11:11-7↗ prob:transverse-jacobi-comparison Suppose $P$ is an embedded hypersurface in a Riemannian manifold $(M, g)$ and $N$ is a unit normal vector field along $P$. Suppose the sectional curvatures of $M$ are bounded below by a constant $c$, and the principal curvatures of $P$ with respect to $-N$ are bounded above by a constant $\lambda $. Let $u$ be the solution to the initial value problem (11.35). Prove that if $b$ is a positive real number such that $u(b) = 0$, then $P$ has a focal point along every geodesic segment with initial velocity $N_p$ for some $p \in P$ and with length greater than or equal to $b$. \end{exercise}
